Strict cleaning pipeline

Source: R/pipeline.R
pipeline_strict_clean.Rd

Minimal pipeline + aggressive deduplication + winsorisation of salary + strict imputation. Optionally removes rows outside valid ranges.

Usage

pipeline_strict_clean(
  data,
  required_columns = NULL,
  strict = TRUE,
  dedup_keys = NULL,
  dedup_keep = c("first", "last"),
  cap_col = "salary_in_usd",
  cap_lower = 0.01,
  cap_upper = 0.99,
  cap_side = c("both", "upper", "lower"),
  cap_verbose = FALSE,
  check_ranges = TRUE,
  ranges_min_year = 2000,
  ranges_max_year = as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y")),
  impute_verbose = FALSE,
  cat_constant = "NA"
)

Arguments

data

A data.frame.

required_columns

Optional character vector of required columns.

strict

Stop on missing required columns when TRUE (default).

dedup_keys

Columns used for deduplication; NULL uses all columns.

dedup_keep

"first" (default) or "last" row to keep when duplicates are detected.

cap_col

Column to winsorise (default "salary_in_usd"). If the column is missing or not numeric the step is skipped with a warning.

cap_lower

Lower quantile for winsorisation (default 0.01).

cap_upper

Upper quantile for winsorisation (default 0.99).

cap_side

Side to cap: "both" (default), "upper" or "lower".

cap_verbose

Logical, forwarded to cap_outliers_salary.

check_ranges

Logical. When TRUE (default) remove rows failing validate_ranges if the needed columns are present.

ranges_min_year, ranges_max_year

Bounds passed to validate_ranges.

impute_verbose

Logical, forwarded to impute_missing.

cat_constant

Value used when imputing categorical columns with the "new_level" strategy.

Value

A cleaned data.frame.
